newsitem.title: USA: Vulcan Materials adds to stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Vulcan Materials adds to stock buyback.

text.p: Vulcan Materials Co said Friday it authorized the purchase of an additional 3,338,460 shares of its outstanding common stock, continuing the authorization for share purchases that began in 1985.
With this action, Vulcan is now authorized to purchase a total of 4,000,000 shares, which represents 11.7 percent of shares outstanding at Dec 31.

From September 1985 through December 1996, Vulcan bought 12,816,971 shares under earlier authorizations at a total cost of $487.9 million. Shares purchased during this period, net of shares issued, reduced outstanding shares by 26 percent.
